items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: One Saturday he came over here to play with my band, with me

ctx.x: I saw him at the bank with a couple of months or a meeting. Yeah. That Miles there we was trying to figure out what was Tess's name and I couldn't think of him. I knew him. At the same time I was talking about Tiddy Tat, the puzzle of the letter. But I knew I thought about Alexander's name. Yeah, that's his name. He's not Alexander's name. He's not Alexander's name. He's not Alexander's name. He's not Alexander's name. I remember where he is.

One Saturday he came over here to play with my band, with me and we had meatballs and spaghetti for dinner. Tex got drunk and left out there with a spaghetti sandwich. I knew I was trying to go out there. That was one of my biggest spaghetti sandwich in my life. That's a new one on me.
